item.title: J&K Rainfall Deficit Soars to 86% Amid Prolonged Dry Spell; Water Bodies Recede, Forest Fire Risk Rises
item.description: JAMMU: Jammu and Kashmir continues to reel under an extended dry spell, with the rainfall deficit widening dramatically to around 86 percent, triggering widespread concerns over diminishing water levels and heightened forest fire vulnerability. item.title: Temperature drops at most places in Kashmir
item.description: SRINAGAR: The residents in Kashmir experienced a colder night as the mercury in most places of the valley dropped, even as shallow fog engulfed many parts, officials said on Thursday. item.title: Luthra Brothers Detained in Thailand After Goa Nightclub Inferno That Killed 25; Deportation to India Likely Soon
item.description: NEW DELHI: Saurabh and Gaurav Luthra, co-owners of the Goa nightclub, were detained by Thai Police early Thursday at the request of Indian authorities, sources confirmed. The duo fled India after last week’s devastating blaze at their establishment, which claimed 25 lives. The brothers had travelled to Phuket, Thailand, shortly after the incident.
